name: Brimstone Heart, Lesser
body:
School transmutation [evil]; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You take on an aspect of a fiendish being, including some of its physical characteristics. You gain low-light vision, resistance to cold 5, resistance to fire 5, and the benefits of protection from good.
